messages:
Liz P: Morning — quick day-of cheat sheet for interviewers. Please skim — we only need confirmation on scribe + debrief lead per room by 9:30. Copy + small asks below.

Omar K: I can scribe Room A. Will keep ASR off unless candidate opts in. :thumbsup:

Tess R: Debrief lead for Room A, thanks. Quick question — are we still doing ‘one line + bullets’ for comments?

Liz P: Yes, prefer bullets. Template: Candidate Name — score — 3 bullets. Example: `Anya — 7/10 — clear system thinking; missed edge-cases; shipped infra at scale`.

Liz P: Current timing for today: 20m coding / 15m design / 10m culture / 10m debrief. Put scores in Notion within 15m of call end.

Liz P: Quick checklist (paste into room channel if helpful):
```
Room A: scribe — @omar_k, debrief lead — @tess_r
Room B: scribe — TBD, debrief lead — @jun_h
Checklist:
- Confirm camera + mic 5m before
- Ask ASR consent (off by default)
- Use Notion eval form: short bullets + numerical score
- Capture 1 takeaway for hiring manager
```

Liz P: Rubric we landed on for today (we changed it last week): Tech 45 / Product 35 / Collaboration 20. Please weight comments to match those buckets.

Tess R: Got it. Can you share the eval link?

Liz P: Sure — run this to open the form quickly:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_TOKEN" \ 
  "https://internal.redwood.co/evals/dayof?room=A" | jq .help_text
```

Omar K: I added a short checklist to Room A calendar invite.

Jun H: I can be debrief lead for Room B, but need someone to scribe. If no volunteers, I can scribe and Priya can float as lead.

Priya M: Can float to Room B at 10:40, confirmed. Also will take final archival notes in Notion after both debriefs.

ops-notify-bot: Reminder scheduled: interviewer check-in at 09:00 for today’s interviews.

Tess R: One minor clarification — how do we handle 'tie' scores? Do we average or pick debrief lead call?

Liz P: If scores differ by 2+ points, debrief lead facilitates a 3-min quick sync and we record a consensus rationale (1 sentence). If still tied, hiring manager gets final call.

Omar K: Taking Room A scribe duty. Will post a short capture example right after the session.

Jun H: Will be on Room B standby until 10:40, then lead if needed.

Liz P: thanks all — DM me if you run into any room or calendar problems. I'll ping again at 08:50 with final roster. :party-parrot:
